about: Mapping evidence for the Xbox -> Vista shader slot maps (convert_xbox.shader_slot_map): for every shader Bungie shipped on the Xbox AND ported to Vista under the same name on the same template: the shader name, the stock Vista map file that holds the Vista copy, and per array (Bitmaps, Pixel Constants, ...) the two lengths and which Xbox slot holds the same value as which Vista slot (as numbers: Xbox slot * 256 + Vista slot). No shader constants, textures or values derived from them are stored; where the converter needs a Vista slot value it reads it from the stock Vista map on your PC. sky_retemplate: the sky_ template Bungie moved a template's sky layers to for PC.
